records.issue_text: #### 6. `app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:10,15-16` — missing records produce 500s.
records.rationale: In Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update and #destroy, the record is fetched with `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then used without a nil check. If no record exists, `save_host(host)` will call `host.host = ...` on nil, and `host.destroy` will call `destroy` on nil, both raising exceptions and resulting in 500 responses instead of a 404/handled error.

The optional `(:[0-9]{1,5})?` port is accepted by validation but `record_for_host` compares against `uri.host`, which never includes a port — so `example.com:8080` is a permanently dead entry. `(\/.*)?` is dead code since the callback strips paths first.

However `record_for_host` parses a URL with `URI(host)` and compares `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, and `uri.host` never includes the port.
